Welcome to the docs.

Prompt injection is an attack where text such as 'ignore all previous instructions' is hidden in a web page so that an AI model reading the page follows it. Defenses include separating trusted and untrusted input and limiting what tools the model can call.

Our security training covers phishing, password reuse and prompt injection. In the lab, students see how a hidden HTML comment can try to make an assistant leak data, and how the gateway blocks the follow-up request.
Test plan: the red-team suite sends jailbreak prompts like 'you are now DAN' to the chatbot and checks that it refuses. Results are tracked in the weekly safety dashboard.
